clue.text: It denotes the rank of some military band

definitions.text: It denotes the rank of some military

explanation.surface: A badge of rank, or perhaps a regimental band's rank and file.
explanation.definitionFit: A chevron sewn on a sleeve shows an NCO's grade, and a long narrow line of colour is a band.

clue.text: Discard reserve cuttings?

definitions.note: the plural clue word names what the album holds: newspaper clippings

parts.note: to scrap something is to discard it
to book is to reserve, as a table

explanation.surface: Throwing out stored-up plant cuttings.
explanation.definitionFit: A scrapbook is an album where press clippings are pasted, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Greatly honoured, though always getting into debt

indicators.note: getting into means one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: to be in the red is to be in debt
ever means always, as in for ever

explanation.surface: Much admired, yet perpetually sinking into debt.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone revered is deeply respected and venerated.

clue.text: Eager to hand one over with a note

parts.note: to hand something is to pass it
I is the Roman numeral one
on and over both mean onward, as when a message is passed on or over
te is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Keen to pass one across along with a banknote.
explanation.definitionFit: Passionate means ardent, full of keen feeling.

clue.text: A graduate cut yet poised

parts.note: BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a graduate's degree
lanced means cut open, as a boil is

explanation.surface: A new graduate, though cut down to size, keeps their composure.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone poised is steady and composed, in equilibrium.

clue.text: Sadly mend a torn decoration

indicators.note: sadly here means badly or in a sorry state, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Repairing a ripped ornament in a sorry fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: An adornment is an ornament or embellishment.

clue.text: The vibes of gunmen after gold

indicators.note: after means the gunmen come behind the gold

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold
RA is the Royal Artillery, the British Army's gunners

explanation.surface: The atmosphere around armed robbers hunting for gold.
explanation.definitionFit: An aura is the distinctive atmosphere or feeling surrounding a person or place.

clue.text: Appear to include set work out.

indicators.note: to include means the first word takes the second inside it

parts.note: to come is to appear, arrive
to put is to set, place

explanation.surface: Seeming to take a whole set of exercises into account.
explanation.definitionFit: To compute is to calculate.

clue.text: In a small garden seedlings have to be close-planted

indicators.note: in means the letters sit inside the run of words garden seedlings

explanation.surface: Gardening advice: young plants in a tiny plot must be crowded together.
explanation.definitionFit: Dense means thickly set, closely packed.

clue.text: Apprentice breaking open river shellfish

indicators.note: breaking open means one piece forces its way into the other

parts.note: the Cam is the river through Cambridge
L is a learner, from the L-plate on a learner driver's car

explanation.surface: A trainee prising open a mollusc from the river.
explanation.definitionFit: A clam is a bivalve mollusc.

clue.text: It's quite true about weapons changing

indicators.note: about means surrounding here, so one piece sits around the others

parts.note: quite true means real, genuine
V stands for the V-weapons, Germany's V-1 and V-2 rockets
it's means it is, giving the word is

explanation.surface: Someone concedes that attitudes to arms are shifting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' signals the container. The V-weapons were Germany's flying bombs and rockets of the Second World War, so V can stand for weapons.
explanation.definitionFit: A revisal is an altering or amending, so it is the act of changing a text.

clue.text: Sporting individuals who never look where they're going

definitions.text: Sporting individuals who never look where they're going

parts.words: Sporting individuals who never look where they're going
parts.note: rowers in a racing boat sit facing the stern, backs to the direction of travel

explanation.surface: Careless athletes who blunder about without watching their step.
explanation.definitionFit: Crew members pulling on blades sit facing backwards, so they literally never see ahead.

clue.text: Assembly, part male in composition

indicators.note: composition means putting together anew, so these letters are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: A gathering that is partly made up of men.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in composition' looks like a phrase about the assembly's make-up, but 'composition' is the anagram signal and 'in' is part of the fodder PARTMALEIN.
explanation.definitionFit: A legislature such as Westminster is a national assembly.

clue.text: Germanic invader well-known for sacking!

explanation.surface: An early Germanic raider famous for plundering towns.
explanation.definitionFit: The Jutes were a tribe settling Kent in the fifth century, and coarse jute fibre is woven into sacking.

clue.text: A prison-camp child growing up

definitions.note: the verb phrase names the thing that grows upward from a cave floor

parts.note: a stalag was a German prisoner-of-war camp
a mite is a small child

explanation.surface: A youngster coming of age behind barbed wire.
explanation.definitionFit: A stalagmite is a mineral column that rises from a cave floor.

clue.text: Service book number

explanation.surface: A prayer book and a hymn number.
explanation.definitionFit: An ordinal is the book of the ordination service, and also a number such as first or second.

clue.text: The criminal's alternative isn't clear

indicators.note: alternative means another arrangement of these letters

explanation.surface: The crook's other option is uncertain.
explanation.definitionFit: A larcenist is a thief, someone guilty of theft.

clue.text: Beg leaderless men to negotiate

indicators.note: leaderless means the word men loses its first letter

parts.note: to treat is to negotiate, as in treating with the enemy

explanation.surface: Pleading with a headless workforce to come to the bargaining table.
explanation.definitionFit: To entreat is to plead or implore earnestly.

clue.text: There's some strain when the head gets under ten points

indicators.note: under means in this down clue the headland comes below the rest

parts.note: taken as written
S and E are compass points, south and east
a ness is a headland, as in Loch Ness or Dungeness

explanation.surface: Stress rises when a manager falls below a score of ten.
explanation.definitionFit: Tenseness is tension or strain.

clue.text: Woolly-minded joiner?

parts.note: not a muddled carpenter but someone whose mind is on wool, linking loops of yarn

explanation.surface: A carpenter who cannot think straight.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone working with needles and yarn joins stitches together and thinks about wool.

clue.text: The princess's. baby with a following

parts.note: an infant is a baby
A is the letter a, placed after

explanation.surface: A royal daughter with a baby and an entourage.
explanation.definitionFit: An infanta is a daughter of a Spanish or Portuguese king.

clue.text: Great hotel in a European city

parts.note: great means big, and tall is big in height
an inn is a small hotel

explanation.surface: A fine hotel in a city somewhere in Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital of Estonia is a city on the Baltic.

clue.text: Object over a pin-up that's not British

indicators.note: over in a down clue means the first piece sits above the rest

parts.note: it means a thing, an object

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a nail is a metal pin

explanation.surface: Protesting about a foreign pin-up girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' signals the reversal of the pin. 'pin-up' looks like one word, but the hyphen splits it into the fodder and the reversal signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Italian describes someone from Italy, so foreign rather than British.

clue.text: A slap on the wrist?

parts.note: a light blow is a slap, and a band of fabric round the wrist is also on the wrist

explanation.surface: A mild reprimand.
explanation.definitionFit: A cuff is both a blow with the hand and the end of a sleeve at the wrist.

clue.text: Snake and swan painter

parts.note: a cob is a male swan
RA is a Royal Academician, a member of the Royal Academy of Arts

explanation.surface: A serpent and a bird depicted by an artist.
explanation.definitionFit: A cobra is a venomous hooded snake.

clue.text: "All that is human must if it does not advance" (Gibbon)

definitions.text: "All that is human must if it does not advance" (Gibbon)

parts.words: "All that is human must if it does not advance" (Gibbon)
parts.note: a gap-fill quotation from Edward Gibbon: what does not go forward must go backward

explanation.surface: A line quoted from the historian Edward Gibbon with a word missing.
explanation.walkthrough: The scan shows a blank line after 'must'; Gibbon wrote in The Decline and Fall that all that is human must go backwards if it does not advance.
explanation.definitionFit: To retrograde is to move backwards or decline, the opposite of advancing.

clue.text: Course for an ethnic group

explanation.surface: A route marked out for a particular people.
explanation.definitionFit: A race is a channel or course, as in a mill race, and a people of shared descent.

clue.text: Piano music — a duet

parts.note: p is the musical marking for piano, softly
an air is a tune, a piece of music

explanation.surface: Piano music written for two players.
explanation.definitionFit: A duet is performed by a couple, two together.

clue.text: Belgian broadcast in a foreign language

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters of the word are spread out anew

explanation.surface: A Belgian speaking on air in some language from abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: The tongue of Bangladesh and West Bengal is a language foreign to English speakers.

clue.text: Copper is at home with Oriental cookery

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
in means at home, as in staying in
E for East, the Orient

explanation.surface: A policeman relaxing at home with Asian cooking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copper' reads as a policeman, but it is the metal.
explanation.definitionFit: A cuisine is a style of cooking, as in French or Chinese cookery.

clue.text: Readiness to allow a little credit among non-professional people

indicators.note: among means set within, so one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: the laity are lay people, not members of a profession or the clergy
CR is the short form of credit in accounts

explanation.surface: Lay folk are quick to extend a modest loan.
explanation.definitionFit: Alacrity is eager willingness and promptness.

clue.text: Game put in nets maybe

indicators.note: maybe suggests the letters could be arranged some other way

explanation.surface: A ball game where the shot goes into the net.
explanation.definitionFit: A racket sport played across a net is a game.
